title: Colors of the Guild / ギルドの色

metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Baroque-pop aftermath × gothic orchestral resolve × restrained choral uplift. 110 BPM steady 4/4. Harpsichord softened, legato strings, warm pipe organ pads, no aggressive snare (use low tom heartbeat instead). Choir enters gradually, not triumphant but grounded. Subtle waterfall ambience in background.

**Vocal Direction:** Rebel lead (mezzo/tenor) clear, reflective, no theatrical excess. Occasional soprano echo (Queen motif transformed, gentle). Guild choir steady and supportive, not dominant.

**Mood:** Responsibility accepted without glory. Bittersweet maturity. Integration.

**Structure:** Quiet Overture → Verse 1 (Rebel) → Pre-Chorus (choir hum) → Chorus (theme statement) → Verse 2 (Rebel confronting bitterness) → Bridge (Queen motif reappears softly) → Final Chorus (choir full but restrained) → Calm Coda.
metadata.prompt:
## OVERTURE — Impact

*(snare crack; organ blast; strings in furious motion)*

Stone splits.
Steel rings.

The sanctuary screams.

## CLASH — Crossed Blades

Choir:
Fracture the arch! Hold the line!

Rebel:
Not for glory—
For the spine—

Queen:
You dare raise hands
against my sign?

*(orchestra surges; rapid string runs)*

## REBEL DECLARATION

*(music tightens; snare steady)*

I did not come to take your throne.
I came because the ground has groaned.

Justice twisted into flame—

I will not let it burn the frame.

証よりも
今は守る。

## GUILD DECREE

*(choir unified, rhythmic and firm)*

Continuity.
Preservation.

System over coronation.

No more spectacle.
No more fall.

The structure must outlive us all.

## QUEEN ASCENSION — Fury Peak

*(soprano soaring, rapid high notes)*

Structure bends to sovereign will!
I forged the sky—
I reign still!

If stone has cracked,
It cracked for me!

I am the axis of decree!

鷹は落ちぬ！

*(orchestra at maximum blaze; tempo pushes forward)*

## SUDDEN SILENCE

*(all instruments cut except distant waterfall)*

—

## THE REBEL — Simple Truth

*(low strings re-enter; no snare)*

Look at me.

I wear their colors.

Not because they chose me.

Because I chose this.

If you win—
There is no world left to rule.

## THE MOMENT

*(single sustained chord; soprano breath audible)*

Queen (soft, trembling under control):

…

## STAND DOWN COMMAND

*(organ low; no frenzy)*

Stand down.

*(pause)*

I said—

Stand.
Down.

号令の断絶。

## ORCHESTRAL RELEASE

*(strings shift to major undertone; choir sustained hum; snare absent)*

Choir (soft):
The blade lowers.
The storm recedes.

Rebel (low):
No victory.

Queen (steady):
No defeat.

Waterfall rises in volume.

## CODA

*(orchestra thins; organ warm; choir sustained)*

Not broken.

Not crowned.

Breath held—

Then released.

息。
